title: PhaseDigest
description: The only summarisation in the system: under 300 tokens at each phase transition. Single writer: Controller (every transition). Append-only; a correction is a new record referencing this one.

id.description: Record id: a lower-case type prefix, a hyphen, at least three digits. Unique within a run.

ledger_version.description: The ledger version this record was written against. A CandidateRecord citing a version other than the frozen one is rejected by the Scribe.

references.description: Ids of the records this one is derived from or responds to. Never edit those records; reference them.

text.description: Under 300 tokens. What the phase produced and what the next phase receives.

trimmed.description: Records trimmed on input-window overflow, largest first, disclosed here. The ledger and the acceptance criteria are never trimmed.
